author_instruction: Can put the pangram test at the end of each paragraph generation so we do t waste time creating a whole document.
applies_to: The separately selected and bound construction-first procedure revision.
change: Generate one paragraph, check all four authorial layers, submit that exact paragraph to Pangram, and require a current acceptable result before generating the next paragraph.
sequence: generate one paragraph through the expression provider
check conceptual, epistemic, rhetorical and linguistic fidelity
submit exact checked paragraph to Pangram
persist detector result against paragraph, assessment and text hash
continue to next paragraph only after a current passing gate
assemble paragraphs and obtain author validation
stop_conditions: malformed response or unexpected detector version
changed paragraph, construction, assessment, voice evidence or bound input
gate_policy: all-human-v1: zero AI and AI-assisted fractions, no AI/assisted segment counts, and all returned windows classified Human Written
repair: Preserve the failed paragraph and findings. Detector flags pause progression and do not automatically trigger paraphrasing or enter the expression prompt. Existing diagnosed four-layer repair remains a separate code path.
authority: A passing detector observation permits paragraph progression; it does not establish authorial voice, truth or final author approval.
preservation: Earlier procedure files, rules, ledgers, drafts and observations remain unchanged. This addendum changes detector timing and paragraph progression, not the four voice layers.
